text:
Iris Chen: Heads up — planning a cutover for client-bindings v1.2 -> v1.3. Target window Tue 2026-03-10 02:00 UTC. Who can own deploy + smoke?
Priya Nair: I can take deploy. Will do the rollout from bastion. :raised_hands:
Sam Turner: I can run the smoke checklist and do quick perf checks after deploy.
Eli Rosen: Any breaking changes to public client interfaces? We need a short compatibility matrix to send to partner integrators.
Iris Chen: No public API surface changes, only client bindings and some serialization fixes. Backcompat should be fine but we added an optional param to the client factory — older clients ignore it. Still, let's validate.
Jorge Silva: I'll draft the partner note after we confirm matrix. Suggest: email + statuspage update + one pager in /docs/client-bindings.
Maya Patel: Rollback plan? If something is bad, what's the quick revert?
Priya Nair: Rollback plan: 1) redeploy tag v1.2-server to canaries, 2) flip feature flag `client_bindings_v1_3` off, 3) revert helm release to previous revision. I can execute steps; need confirmation on DB-safe gated things.
Sam Turner: Smoke checklist I'm planning:
```
- deploy to canary (3 instances)
- run integration tests against canary (auth, token refresh, streaming)
- run 1k synthetic requests through the SDK trace harness
- check 95p latency, error rate < 0.5%
- validate logs for serialization warnings
```
QA-Bot: Auto-check: run test-suite:clients/integration — started when canary is up. Will post results.
Eli Rosen: Also add a quick schema diff for serialized payloads. If we detect added non-optional fields, halt.
Iris Chen: Good call. Priya — can you schedule canary deploy at 01:30 UTC, then full cutover at 02:00 UTC? Allows 30m for canary smoke.
Priya Nair: Yes — I'll do canary 01:30 and promote at ~02:00 if no blockers. Will log timestamps in the runbook.
Jorge Silva: For client comms: tentative copy: "We will roll client-bindings v1.3 on Tue Mar 10 02:00 UTC. No breaking API changes expected. If you rely on private internals, reach out." Will share a draft in #customer-success for review.
Maya Patel: Who's owner for monitoring during the window? Need someone to watch dashboards and paging.
Sam Turner: I'm on monitoring until 03:00 UTC. Can take alerts for latency and error spikes.
Iris Chen: Great. Owners: Priya (deploy/rollback), Sam (smoke/monitor), Jorge (comms), Eli (compatibility checks), QA-Bot (auto-tests).
Priya Nair: One more technical note — the deploy includes a config change to `max_kv_cache_size` default on canaries. If we see increased memory OOMs, rollback immediately.
Eli Rosen: I'll run the schema diff now and paste results before canary.
QA-Bot: Integration tests queued. Will post report as soon as canary URL available.
Priya Nair: I'll tag the release `client-bindings-1.3-20260310` and push the helm changes to staging repo.
Iris Chen: Thanks. After smoke pass, we do a controlled promote, then watch for 30m before marking done. If any partner hits issues, Jorge will coordinate.
Jorge Silva: I'll also prepare a short rollback FAQ to answer partner questions quickly.
Sam Turner: please ping me in-thread when canary promotion starts so I can kick off the 1k request harness.
Priya Nair: will do. tagging ppl: @Sam Turner @Eli Rosen @Jorge Silva @Maya Patel :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Scheduled deploy for tag client-bindings-1.3-20260310 at 2026-03-10T01:30:00Z to canary cluster.
Iris Chen: all set. feel free to DM if you need me during the window. Good luck! :rocket:
